hint.text:
Exclamation marks are not used in formal speech and writing.

Informal: I am very excited about the holidays!

Formal: I am very excited about the holidays.
hint.sound: Exclamation marks are not used in formal speech and writing.  For example, informally you could say 'I am very excited about the holidays!' with an exclamation mark, and formally you could say 'I am very excited about the holidays.' without an exclamation mark.

instruction.text: Find all the sentences with exclamation marks in the text.

atoms.b: ((I’m so excited!)) Today, my family and I are going to a theme park and I cannot wait to go on the rollercoasters. ((I’m a real thrill-seeker!)) It is rather frustrating as my younger brother does not like rollercoasters and prefers to watch. ((How boring!)) At least my father will come on the rides with me. ((He’s the best!))

instruction.text: Find all the sentences with exclamation marks in the text.

atoms.b: Climate change is one of the most significant threats to humanity in the 21st century. ((It’s so dangerous!)) We must join together as a planet to tackle this issue and prevent irreversible damage. ((We need to act now!)) The biggest priority is lowering our greenhouse gas emissions, decreasing the use of fossil fuels and switching to renewable energy sources. ((But it won’t be easy!))
